name: Gameplay fixtures: NPC spell-hit bonuses retain native defaults and land original Magic damage
contract: A same-level NPC Magic input has a native 96 percent base hit chance. The optional fixture spell_hit_bonus
adds percentage points through the native Unit modifier. An unconfigured NPC keeps zero bonus; four points
supply the remaining accuracy, and the 100-point fixture remains capped by the native hit calculation.
Original QA Holy spell 45648 has 999 base points plus one die point, Magic defense and CANT_CRIT. Both
configured level-80 fixtures must therefore remove exactly 1000 health from a level-80 unshielded player.
The unconfigured control remains at zero before and after both real damage inputs. No DBC attribute or
production hit rule changes, and ordinary unconfigured NPCs are not required to win a random hit roll.
